title: Structured ask form and routing for enterprise usage insights
creator: Priya Singh
description: Design and deliver a lightweight structured ‘ask’ form and automated routing rules for enterprise console and reporting requests. Many enterprise customers submit ad-hoc requests for usage analytics, cost breakdowns, and exports via email or support tickets. This work creates a standardized intake that captures the minimal context needed to prioritize, route to the right team (self-serve, Analytics, Solutions, Engineering), and apply a reproducible priority score. The goal is to reduce back-and-forth discovery, surface high-impact asks faster, and create metrics to track request velocity and SLAs.
goals: Reduce initial discovery turn-around time from average 5 business days to <48 hours
Automatically classify and route 70% of incoming enterprise reporting requests to the correct owner
Surface top 3 recurring ask patterns and create templated self-serve responses for them
Maintain clear audit trail and links to customer work artifacts (PRs, dashboards, exports)
acceptance_criteria: A hosted intake form (Console + internal support UI link) that captures: tenant, objective, time range, output format, sample query, desired cadence, SLA expectation, and business impact
Routing rules implemented that map asks to: self-serve docs, analytics team, solutions engineering, or engineering backlog
Priority scoring algorithm documented and implemented as a simple rule set (impact, urgency, repeatability, data sensitivity)
Dashboards created to track request source, time-to-triage, time-to-closure, and percent auto-routed
Stakeholder sign-off from Analytics lead and Solutions lead on the fields captured and routing decisions
proposed_flow_steps: Customer or CSM clicks ‘Request Usage/Cost Insights’ from console or file ticket via support portal
Form collects structured metadata and creates a Linear ticket with standardized template
Automated classification runs and assigns priority score and target owner group
If auto-route -> notify assignee and create task with standardized checklist; if human review required -> route to intake triage queue
Workowner updates ticket with link to artifacts (dashboard, export link, PR) and ticket moves to Done when export/dash delivered
routing_rules: If objective == 'cost breakdown' and time_range <= 30d -> route to Analytics (fast-turn template)
If cadence == 'recurring' and output_format == 'dashboard' -> route to Solutions + Analytics for templated pipeline
If data_sensitivity == 'high' -> route to Security & Compliance review before provisioning exports
If request contains predefined template id or matches FAQ -> auto-suggest self-serve doc and close with feedback link
scoring_criteria: Repeatability: one-off vs recurring (Recurring boosts score)
Effort estimate: quick win (<2h), small (2-8h), medium (8-40h), large (>40h)

notes_and_decisions: Decision: Keep the initial form intentionally minimal to drive adoption; add advanced fields behind 'show more'
Trade-off: We accept some false negatives on auto-routing (manual triage) to avoid over-assigning sensitive data requests incorrectly
Decision: Use a deterministic scoring rule (no ML for launch) so behaviour is auditable and editable by PMs
Follow-up: If >20% of requests fall into a recurring template within 2 months, create a self-serve dashboard template and document the pipeline
